crime_description: Releasing a swarm of genetically modified, glowing bees to disrupt a high-profile outdoor wedding. Interrogators should probe for connections to an insider, a hidden agenda, remote coordination, hidden assets, and an elaborate escape plan.

suspect.name: Kaelen Voss
suspect.fake_alibi: Kaelen claims he was participating in an underground virtual reality gaming tournament under the handle 'NullZone' from midnight until dawn.

secrets.value: Dr. Aris Thorne, a disgruntled lead researcher at CyberDyne who bypassed the biometric security locks.
Kaelen needed to sell the technology on the black market to pay for his sister's life-saving cybernetic organ replacement.
was actively coordinating the crime from a secure burner phone
untraceable offshore account holding the illicit funds
chartered a private flight under a fake identity
